concepts.name: African Plate
concepts.definition: Major tectonic plate underlying most of Africa and the adjacent Atlantic and Indian Ocean floor, splitting eastward along the East African Rift.

concepts.name: Antarctic Plate
concepts.definition: Major tectonic plate containing Antarctica and surrounding Southern Ocean floor, bounded almost entirely by mid-ocean ridges.

concepts.name: Eurasian Plate
concepts.definition: Major tectonic plate underlying most of Europe and Asia, extending west to the Mid-Atlantic Ridge and colliding with the Indian Plate to raise the Himalayas.

concepts.name: Australian Plate
concepts.definition: Major tectonic plate carrying Australia, Tasmania and parts of New Guinea and New Zealand, moving northward to converge with the Eurasian and Pacific plates.

concepts.name: Indian Plate
concepts.definition: Minor tectonic plate carrying the Indian subcontinent, once fused with Australia in the Indo-Australian Plate, colliding northward with the Eurasian Plate to build the Himalayas.

concepts.name: North American Plate
concepts.definition: The Earth's second-largest tectonic plate, spanning most of North America, Greenland, Cuba and parts of northeastern Siberia and Iceland.

concepts.name: Pacific Plate
concepts.definition: The Earth's largest tectonic plate, an oceanic plate underlying most of the Pacific Ocean basin, bounded by trenches, the San Andreas Fault and the East Pacific Rise.

concepts.name: South American Plate
concepts.definition: Major tectonic plate carrying South America and Atlantic seafloor east to the Mid-Atlantic Ridge; the Nazca plate subducts beneath its western edge, raising the Andes.

concepts.name: Arabian Plate
concepts.definition: Minor tectonic plate covering most of the Arabian Peninsula, splitting from Africa along the Red Sea Rift and colliding with Eurasia at the Zagros belt to the north.

concepts.name: Caribbean Plate
concepts.definition: Minor tectonic plate underlying the Caribbean Sea and Central America, bounded by the North American, South American, Nazca and Cocos plates amid intense seismic activity.

concepts.name: Nazca Plate
concepts.definition: Minor oceanic plate off western South America that subducts beneath the South American plate along the Peru-Chile Trench, driving the Andean orogeny.

concepts.name: Philippine Sea Plate
concepts.definition: Minor oceanic plate beneath the Philippine Sea east of the Philippines, largely enclosed by convergent boundaries including the Izu-Bonin-Mariana and Philippine trenches.

concepts.name: Scotia Plate
concepts.definition: Small, mostly submerged tectonic plate between southern South America and Antarctica, encompassing the Drake Passage, Scotia Sea and South Georgia.

concepts.name: Somali Plate
concepts.definition: Minor tectonic plate splitting from Africa along the East African Rift, carrying Madagascar and part of East Africa's coast eastward toward the Indian Ocean.

concepts.name: Sunda Plate
concepts.definition: Minor tectonic plate underlying most of Southeast Asia, including Indochina, Malaysia and the Sunda Islands, with the Australian plate subducting beneath it at the Java Trench.

concepts.name: Cocos Plate
concepts.definition: Young oceanic plate off Central America's Pacific coast, subducting beneath the Caribbean Plate at the Middle America Trench.

concepts.name: Juan de Fuca Plate
concepts.definition: Small oceanic microplate off Washington, Oregon, and British Columbia, subducting beneath North America at the Cascadia subduction zone.
